{{Listen3|Bogg-Seboca-Kenobi.flac|Bogg Tyrell screaming|Bogg Tyrell, Seboca, and Obi-Wan Kenobi all exclaim as they nearly collide<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Bogg Tyrell''' was an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who represented her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]]. On the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she would frequent [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the world's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district. The senator was also occasionally mistaken for the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] Aleena [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Tyrell was a guest of the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]], who showed her around Coruscant's nightspots. In their [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], the pair nearly collided with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], hanging from the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]]. Afterwards, Tyrell later visited Dex's Diner and left with a drink, not realizing the Jedi visiting there as well was Kenobi.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jedi poodoo!|Seboca curses after he and Bogg Tyrell nearly collide with Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=Seboca.flac|<ref name="aotc" />}}
The [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Bogg Tyrell represented her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="DB" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Aleen system/Legends|Aleen system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FF" /> [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB" /> On the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital world of the Republic,<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> she frequented [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="FF" /> in the planet's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district,<ref name="Complete Locations" /> having acquired a taste for its cuisine and atmosphere.<ref name="FF" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Tyrell was occasionally mistaken for [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]], an Aleena [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who had [[Death/Legends|died]] ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Tyrell was a guest of [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]] and travelled the skylines of Coruscant in an open [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] with him as he showed her around the planet's nightspots.<ref name="FF" />

[[File:Seboca_Bogg.png|thumb|right|350px|Tyrell and Seboca nearly collided with Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
While she and Seboca quietly cruised toward [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City's]] [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], Tyrell spotted<ref name="FF" /> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], hanging from the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]<ref name="aotc" /> [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]]<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> to pursue the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempt]] on the life of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Though Kenobi was heading straight towards them, they avoided a collision with the Jedi.<ref name="aotc" /> Tyrell was still able to recognize him as one from his [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]], however. She was happy to be alive after the incident.<ref name="FF" />

Tyrell later visited Dex's Diner while Kenobi was there to get diner owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] help identifying a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|toxic dart]] he had acquired during his investigation of Wesell. She quickly left with a drink in hand,<ref name="aotc" /> not realizing Kenobi was the Jedi she and Seboca had encountered.<ref name="FF" /> The Dug, who was also at the diner, left shortly afterwards.<ref name="aotc" />

==Personality and traits==
Tyrell bared a passing resemblance to Ratts Tyerell, causing her to be often mistaken for him. She was upset that she, a senator, was mistaken for someone she considered a mere Podracer. Tyrell also took issue with the fact that Tyerell was male, and she was female. When driving on Coruscant, she was not a risk-taker and kept herself within the speed limit. The Aleena had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan and blue skin, and stood at a stature of 0.79 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="FF" /> She also had numbed taste buds.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
During her night with Seboca, Tyrell wore a brown and beige [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] and sandals. Over the dress she wore a brown jacket and a silver belt.<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DermotPower-BoggTyrell-Instagram.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bogg Tyrell concept art labeled "dp479"]]
Bogg Tyerell first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The computer-generated model of Ratts Tyerell that had appeared in<ref name="DB2" /> the [[1999]] prequel trilogy film<ref name="Year" /> [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] was reused and modified to create the character.<ref name="DB2">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> Concept artist [[Dermot Power]] made a design of Tyrell's costume in [[August]] of [[2000]], labeled with the production code "dp479."  He was not the designer of the character, however.<ref name="IG">{{Instagram|username=powerdermot|name=[[Dermot Power]]|url=p/COzOKivDA3y|date=2021-05-13|quote=Costume design for Ep 2 creature from a long time ago ... etc. Did not design Bogg Tyrell .|archivefile=File:BoggTyrell-DermotPower-Instagram.png}}</ref> 

Prior to the film's release, she was first pictured in the "[[Prequel Update]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 59|fifty-ninth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', written by [[Dan Madsen]]<ref name="Insider59">{{InsiderCite|59|Prequel Update}}</ref> and published on [[April 2]], 2002.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020308.html|text=25 Years of ''Star Wars'' in New Insider}}</ref> The character was later identified in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Dex's Diner,<ref name="Dex">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> published on [[July 5]], 2002.<ref name="DBdate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/07/news20020705.html|text=On the Hunter's Trail}}</ref> According to [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]], unused text from the [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook|''Attack of the Clones Scrapbook'']],<ref name="UnusedScrapbook">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1125#16098316|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-12-28|time=4:01 PM|quote=They're unrelated. Unused text for the ''Attack of the Clones Scrapbook'' had intended to point out this fact.}}</ref> authored by [[Ryder Windham]]<ref name="Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> and published on [[April 24]], [[2002]],<ref name="SW.com2">{{SWArchive|url=eu/news/2002/04/news20020426.html|text=Episode II Books from Random House}}</ref> was going to establish her as having no relation to [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell's]] [[Tyerell|wife]].<ref name="UnusedScrapbook" />
